business_problem: Telexpress wanted to replace rigid IVR workflows with natural, low-latency AI voicebots and chatbots that enterprise customers could adapt to their own routing rules and service processes.
solution_summary: Telexpress uses Google Cloud to address this challenge: Telexpress wanted to replace rigid IVR workflows with natural, low-latency AI voicebots and chatbots that enterprise customers could adapt to their own routing rules and service processes. Gemini Live API drives the natural voice interactions at the heart of the company’s AI voicebot offering, serving as the serving layer. Gemini 2.5 Flash powers instant, accurate text-based customer service responses for chatbot deployments, serving as the compute layer. Google Kubernetes Engine deploys the AI solutions in autopilot mode so the DevOps team spends less time on infrastructure, serving as the orchestration layer. Customer voice calls enter Gemini Live API, RAG and intent-based routing align each interaction to enterprise workflows, Gemini 2.5 Flash handles text-service channels, and GKE Autopilot runs the platform with less infrastructure overhead.
